brief.audience: External readers and Power Pages makers evaluating an editorial publication starter.
brief.job: Discover practical articles, filter the archive, read long-form content, and understand who wrote it.
brief.primaryAction: Read the featured story or browse the article archive.
brief.principalDoubt: Whether the publication structure and sample content are real enough to adapt without misrepresenting a live editorial organization.
brief.proof: Eight visible fictional articles, explicit fictional-content labels, three complete author profiles, and working search and topic filters.
brief.thesis: A confident modern journal with oversized literary type, warm paper surfaces, compact editorial metadata, and a recurring issue-arch motif.
brief.signatureMoment: The home-page issue arch pairs a numbered publication marker with the featured article.

categories.name: First impression and clarity
categories.evidence: Home desktop/mobile immediately states the publication thesis, offers one featured-story action, and pairs it with a complete article preview; archive, article, authors, and profile routes use explicit task headings.

categories.name: Attention and hierarchy
categories.evidence: Every desktop/mobile first screen has one dominant Newsreader heading, with restrained metadata and controls; the home issue arch, article title, and author portrait each establish an unmistakable focal point.

categories.name: Cognitive fluency and usability
categories.evidence: Articles desktop/mobile uses one search field and one topic selector with a live result count; cards expose topic, title, summary, author, and reading time in a stable scan pattern.

categories.name: Narrative and page flow
categories.evidence: Home moves from thesis to featured proof to publication promise and recent stories; article pages move from context and byline through readable body content to an author handoff.

categories.name: Copy and value communication
categories.evidence: Headlines, excerpts, filter labels, bylines, reading times, and calls to action are concrete and editorially consistent across all five routes, without generic placeholder copy.

categories.name: Trust and proof
categories.evidence: Home promise band, archive introduction, author profile note, and persistent footer clearly label the content and people as fictional while demonstrating eight complete posts and three profiles.

categories.name: Brand and visual coherence
categories.evidence: All routes use the Newsreader/Inter pair, warm paper palette, brick accent, black editorial bands, circular author marks, letterform story art, and one consistent rounded-card system.

categories.name: Responsive and accessible design
categories.evidence: Five routes retain hierarchy and readable line lengths at desktop/mobile widths; 10 axe scans pass at score 100 with zero violations or incomplete checks, and focus/reduced-motion handling is present.

categories.name: Interaction and motion craft
categories.evidence: src/styles.css defines focus, hover, card-lift, navigation, and reduced-motion states; App.tsx announces archive result changes and resets route scroll without delayed animation.

categories.name: Detail and memorable finish
categories.evidence: Desktop/mobile evidence shows consistent alignment, card geometry, first-letter treatment, issue numbering, author marks, metadata spacing, and a footer-integrated Power Pages badge without overlap.

criticalGates.name: Clear offering and primary CTA
criticalGates.evidence: The home first screen identifies a practical editorial publication and makes Read the featured story the primary action; every secondary route names its task.

criticalGates.name: Single first-impression focal point
criticalGates.evidence: Each route has one dominant heading or profile identity at both widths, with controls and metadata visibly subordinate.

criticalGates.name: Accessible primary flow
criticalGates.evidence: Desktop/mobile Playwright axe scans cover all five declared routes at score 100 with zero violations and zero incomplete checks; labels, focus, contrast, landmarks, and link names pass.

criticalGates.name: Honest proof and representation
criticalGates.evidence: The interface repeatedly labels articles and contributors as fictional and does not claim live publication, subscriber, or editorial operations.

criticalGates.name: Working mobile layout
criticalGates.evidence: Mobile captures for home, archive, article, authors, and profile show no overlap, clipping, horizontal overflow, or displaced primary action.

criticalGates.name: Verified font loading
criticalGates.evidence: index.html requests Inter weights 400-700 and Newsreader variable weights 500-800; styles.css uses only those ranges with system fallbacks.

criticalGates.name: Specific and coherent visual identity
criticalGates.evidence: The issue arch, literary scale, warm paper palette, editorial metadata, author medallions, and consistent story-card system form a publication-specific identity across every route.
